ashley_arch: quick RFC follow-up: propose a tiny translation layer so runtimes can make fast fallback choices while central observer emits higher-quality signals. tradeoffs: correctness vs latency.

ben_platform: runtime should own immediate decisions. observer supplies verdicts (pass/degrade/fail). keep logic out of clients.

maria_dev: product wants staged degradation: token cap -> quantized variant -> full rollback. need primitives for that.

dave_oncall: ops: require deterministic local runway for control-plane outages. soft-state ok but must be recoverable.

liam_infra: pragmatic storage: local redis AOF for counters + periodic snapshot to central etcd. on restart replay local AOF then reconcile.

ashley_arch: tiny policy example: policy{id:"p-6300",conds:[p95>200ms for 2m],actions:[degrade(max_tokens=128),fallback(variant=stable)],budget:{tokens:500,window:1m},version:"v1"}. unknown fields -> safe fallback.

maria_dev: standardize telemetry keys: rollout.id,policy.version,budget.remaining,fallback.reason,signal.source.

ben_platform: cross-region: router merges observer verdict with local capability map; pick region-compatible variant.

dave_oncall: smoothing: require 2 consecutive windows or weighted score before global pager. local fallback can be immediate but logged.

deploy-bot: rollout 6300000000 started  model=gpt-x-lite variant=v3 canary=2% :rocket:

ashley_arch: action items: maria -> policy proto; ben -> decision API sketch; liam -> redis checkpoint plan; dave -> oncall playbook. 15m sync tomorrow.

ben_platform: will post gRPC sketch.

maria_dev: will list eval metrics and thresholds.

deploy-bot: progress (t+1m): p95 +7ms, quality_delta +0.1%  no action.

dave_oncall: watching escalation_count>1.

ashley_arch: thanks, keep the runtime conservative by default.
